a: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
p: Wa mā yulaqqāhā illa-lladhīna ṣabarū, wa mā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīm.
m: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
